messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] org=nebula-works sustained 5xx surge (10m avg 12%) — org-protect triggered, paging oncall
oncall-olivia: I'm up, looking into it now
sre-mike: pulling graphs — QPS jumped 600->2.2k in ~4m, 503 and 504s mainly, p95 latency doubled, GPU mem ~91% and climbing
eng-raja: checking model logs, lots of KV cache churn and model reloads; looks like a heavy batch import from the customer
support-jess: customer sent a note in support channel: 'we started a bulk ingest, can you avoid killing it? We need it to finish'
pm-ana: Nebula is enterprise, SLA. Prefer temporary mitigation that keeps their job running if possible
netops-lin: infra can take a short burst if we cap it to 15m and enable ephemeral autoscale, but if mem >95% we risk OOMs and node evictions
oncall-olivia: options: (A) temp org QPS bump (1300->2400) with short ttl; (B) throttle other lower-tier org traffic; (C) disable non-essential token-costly features for nebula (reranker, embeddings)
sre-mike: prefer A + C — bump to reduce immediate error rate, and flip off reranker for that org to cut token pressure
eng-raja: I can flip the reranker flag and also adjust KV cache retention for that org to reduce churn
oncall-olivia: applying rate bump now:
```
ri-admin org update-rate --org nebula-works --qps 2400 --burst 3500 --ttl 900 --actor oncall-olivia
```
ops-bot: Action recorded: rate change applied org=nebula-works by oncall-olivia (change_id=chg_20240228_7789)
eng-raja: disabling reranker for org=nebula-works now to lower token usage
ops-bot: Feature flag update: reranker disabled for org=nebula-works by eng-raja
sre-mike: metrics update — 5xx down to ~2.5% in 90s, backlog draining, p95 latency back to baseline+50ms
support-jess: customer confirms their ingest progressed past the failing phase, thanks team
pm-ana: create follow-up ICS ticket for capacity/scale guidance and a pre-warned bump workflow for customers doing bulk jobs
oncall-olivia: INC-2384 created for capacity recommendations and pre-bump UX
netops-lin: I'll propose a transient autoscale policy for large planned migrations (scale earlier by X% when an org's QPS grows >Y within Z minutes)
eng-raja: will add an Optimize suggestion to recommend turning off reranker/embeddings during bulk imports
oncall-olivia: scheduling auto-revert at +15m. leaving monitoring handoff to oncall-ana for overnight. Handoff: temp QPS bump applied, reranker disabled, errors reduced, watching memory. Auto-revert scheduled unless extended. :white_check_mark:
oncall-ana: roger that — I'll watch for mem pressure and revert early if >94% or if 5xx creeps up. Will escalate to SRE if needed
ops-bot: Note: change chg_20240228_7789 will auto-revert at 3998883140 unless updated
oncall-olivia: thanks all, closing loop here — postmortem and follow-ups assigned to INC-2384
